articles.title: Google Engineer Charged With Insider Trading on Polymarket
articles.summary: A Google software engineer was charged with insider trading on Polymarket, where he allegedly made more than $1 million betting on one of last year’s most popular Internet searches.

articles.summary: KKR & Co.’s co-chief executive officer Scott Nuttall said it was likely that the alternative asset manager would eventually start trading private credit, following early efforts by Apollo Global Management Inc. to create a market for less liquid debt.

JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon says, “there might be, in the next couple years, a chance to put $10 billion to $20 billion to work buying something,” adding that JPMorgan is “on the lookout” for a deal. (Source: Bloomberg)
